vr1019114.title: KINUJO Hair Dryer Voyage HW001 Lightweight Foldable Travel Dryer AC100-240V
vr1019114.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vr1019114.details: KINUJO Hair Dryer Voyage HW001, a lightweight foldable travel hair dryer, brand new and genuine. It weighs only about 290 g (body only) and folds small, with a strong airflow of 2.1 cubic meters per minute, far-infrared heat and negative ions. Dual voltage AC100-240V 50/60Hz, 1000 W, maximum temperature about 82 C, with a weak/strong airflow switch and a cool air button, so it can be used in the US and abroad with a plug adapter if needed; the plug is the Japanese two-pin type, which also fits US outlets. Size about 155 x 50 x 180 mm. Included: the nozzle, a pouch and the instruction manual with a warranty card. The photos are product images.
